notes: Evaluations for the umbrella meta-skill. Per-sub-skill evals live in each sub-skill's evals/evals.json.

cases.description: Should trigger: discover unknown unknowns before a build
cases.input: I'm new to audio processing in Python. Help me find my blindspots.
cases.expect: Activate blindspot-pass to surface unknown unknowns
assertions: Surfaces landmines, hidden context, what good looks like

cases.input: I have a spec but some assumptions feel shaky. Interview me.
cases.expect: Activate interview-me for one-question-at-a-time ambiguity resolution

cases.input: I want to build a rate limiter like the one in the auth service.
cases.expect: Activate reference-hunt to read existing code as the spec
assertions: Produces a semantics summary before writing code

cases.input: Write a Python function to parse CSV files.
cases.expect: Recognize as a straightforward implementation task
